svg.title: Federation Square · official 2020 building footprints
svg.desc: 907 ground or podium footprint records. Structures black; bridges excluded. White includes water, rail and unclassified space, not necessarily walkable public space.

g.text: City of Melbourne · CC BY 4.0 · tier 1 structures · bridges excluded
